description: In Logical Reasoning, Coding is a process where a word or number is obscured using a specific rule. Decoding is the process of identifying that hidden rule to extract the actual meaning.

sections.title: Basics of English Alphabet
sections.description: To solve coding questions quickly, it is essential to remember the place values of letters.

key_concepts.explanation: The sum of the place values of letters at the same position from opposite ends of the English alphabet is always 27 (e.g., A(1) + Z(26) = 27).

sections.title: Letter Coding
sections.description: In this type, the letters of a word are replaced by other letters according to a specific pattern.

results: Letters are shifted by +1, +2, or -1, -2 in sequence.
Example: APPLE written as BQQMF (+1 shift).
The letters of the word are written in reverse order.
The pattern can also be written in a cross sequence by splitting the word into halves.

sections.title: Number or Symbol Coding
sections.description: Letters are represented based on their alphabetical place values or by specific symbols.

results: Replacing each letter with its direct place value (A=1, B=2).
Calculating the sum or product of the place values of all letters.
Dividing or multiplying the sum of place values by the total number of letters.

sections.title: Substitution Coding
sections.description: In this, an object or color is given a new name (code), and the question is asked based on that code (e.g., if 'red' is called 'blue').

steps.title: Find the Real Answer
steps.detail: Read the last part of the question and figure out the correct answer based on general knowledge.

steps.title: Identify the Code
steps.detail: Look in the given question to see what new name (code) has been assigned to that 'real answer'.

steps.title: Select Final Answer
steps.detail: The new name given for the actual word will be your correct answer.

sections.title: Sentence or Message Decoding
sections.description: In these questions, a group of sentences is written in special codes. This is often referred to as 'Chinese Coding'.

steps.title: Compare the Sentences
steps.detail: Take at least two sentences from the given data and find the common words between them.

steps.title: Match the Codes
steps.detail: Find the common code for that common word in the respective codes of those sentences.

steps.title: Elimination Method
steps.detail: Eliminate the known codes from the sentences to find the code for the unknown words.
